items.title: Eat Dog Food
items.detail: Take Canned Dog Food from the Weenie Wagon at your C.A.M.P. or another player's camp and consume it.

items.title: Build a Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Open build menu, go to Defense, and place any trap. A Punji Board costs only 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Find them at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go or Grafton Steel.

items.title: Collect a Teddy Bear
items.detail: Northeast of Knife Edge in a half-destroyed shack; use a grenade to knock them down from a ledge.

items.title: Cripple a Mirelurk's Limb
items.detail: Fast travel to Spruce Knob Lake and cripple a Mirelurk's limb with a rifle using V.A.T.S.

items.title: Cripple enemy limbs
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport and cripple Scorched limbs with a rifle; each limb counts separately.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Circuitry
items.detail: Scrap Sensor Modules, Enhanced Targeting Cards, Telephones, or Military-grade Circuit Boards at a workbench.

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Open C.A.M.P. build menu and place any turret or trap under Defense. A Punji Board requires only 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs and harvest from the orange bulbs around the lake, or plant Slipper Cactus at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Visit the Giant Teapot and start the Strange Brew quest, or go to Tanagra Town for up to ten Cave Crickets in the cave.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town's bounty board; the Slasher appears as an uninvited guest during the final stage.

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for up to 34 Cultists; target the head as a weak spot.

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Grab a Protest Sign at Grafton, degrade it by hitting an enemy, then repair it with 1 Wood at a workbench.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it, or use the one at Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters or floater freezer pus sacs at any workbench; Clancy Manor has decanters inside.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Only movement on foot counts, not fast travel; sprinting while under-encumbered covers distance faster.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week by completing any six daily challenges per day.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation chance and bonus caps event running through Monday noon.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All public events feature mutated variants with special rewards from mutated party packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Experience gain is doubled and max XP buffs are active across all activities.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27
events.description: Major update introducing world pets and beginning of Season 27 You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event returns with double mutation chance and special rewards.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed Scorched creatures appear with seasonal rewards and waterlogged gifts.
